title: 庭院午后
description: 同一虚构成年亚洲女性、白 T 恤与牛仔裤、日常庭院、自然光和手机随拍观感的六张系列候选。

base.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE believable everyday smartphone snapshot, casually taken by a friend, of a naturally beautiful FICTIONAL 27-year-old East Asian adult woman. She must clearly have a natural East Asian appearance, expressive dark-brown eyes of ordinary human size, softly defined face, a warm relaxed slight smile, long dark-brown hair loosely tied back with a few stray strands near her cheeks, and understated everyday makeup. Retain real pores, faint under-eye texture, small normal skin-tone variations and natural facial asymmetry; attractive without a beauty filter or porcelain doll skin. Casual outfit: plain soft off-white cotton crewneck T-shirt, medium-blue full-length straight-leg jeans with believable creases and white low-top sneakers. Normal realistic adult proportions. Full-body casual standing, facing the friend with her weight relaxed onto one leg and arms resting comfortably, full head and shoes visible. Location: an ordinary lived-in residential courtyard, light tiled or concrete walkway, pale building wall and a little everyday greenery at the edge, not a studio or luxury photoshoot. Soft ordinary late-afternoon daylight, uneven natural reflected light and modest shadows. Shot with a handheld smartphone main camera in normal PHOTO mode, approximately 26 mm equivalent perspective, portrait 3:4 orientation, chest-height viewpoint, slightly imperfect framing and a very small handheld tilt; the woman slightly off centre. Background remains naturally readable, no artificial portrait-mode bokeh. Believable phone-camera processing, moderate detail, a little fine shadow noise and mild JPEG texture; not hyper-sharp HDR or glossy fashion-ad lighting. The image should feel like a good-looking friend in an unedited personal phone album. One person only. No phone UI, no timestamp, no words, no watermark, no collage. No illustration, painting, CGI, plastic rendering, glamour retouching or doll-like enlarged features.

frames.title: 环境开场
frames.purpose: 先交代庭院与下午氛围，人物只占较小比例。
frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, photorealistic-natural. This is one frame in a coherent six-photo series titled Courtyard Afternoon. IMAGE 1 is the mandatory reference for the SAME fictional 27-year-old adult East Asian woman and the SAME courtyard. Preserve her facial structure, naturally sized dark eyes, gentle relaxed smile, loosely tied-back dark hair and stray strands. Preserve the exact ordinary white crewneck cotton T-shirt, blue full-length jeans, white low-top sneakers, normal adult proportions and natural skin. Preserve the residential courtyard cues: pale building wall and windows to the right, paved walkway, stone-edged planting beds and leafy greenery to the left, dark railing further back. Same soft late-afternoon daylight and casual handheld smartphone main-camera look, approximately 26 mm equivalent perspective, readable background, believable modest phone sharpening/noise/compression. No professional fashion shoot, glamour retouching, plastic skin, cinematic grading, fake portrait blur, drawing or CGI. A friend is taking these casual personal-album photos. Portrait approximately 3:4. One woman only, no text, logo, watermark or inset. IMAGE 2 is a body/gesture reference only; use its relevant pose relationships, not the mannequin appearance. FRAME 1, ESTABLISHING SHOT: the friend stands much farther back, showing considerably more of this same ordinary courtyard. The woman is a small full-body figure, about ONE THIRD of frame height, positioned a little to the right of centre on the walkway, with garden and architecture providing the majority of the image. Loosely follow Image 2's comfortable one-hand-on-hip standing arrangement, other arm down, but natural human balance. Show her complete head and shoes and ample space around her. This MUST look noticeably wider than the baseline and the later full-body hero frame; do not fill the frame with the person. All parts of the scene have ordinary phone-photo depth of field. Coherent real-world scale and grounded feet.
frames.observed: 庭院范围比全身主图更宽，但人物仍占画面约一半高度，没有达到指令中约三分之一的远景目标。
frames.revision: 再拉远人物至画面约 1/3，增加环境留白。

frames.title: 全身主图
frames.purpose: 明确人物与整体穿搭，作为整组的主视觉。
frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, photorealistic-natural. Create ONE everyday handheld SMARTPHONE photograph, not a professional photoshoot. IMAGE 1 is the canonical identity and visual reference: preserve this SAME fictional adult East Asian woman, her natural facial structure, ordinary-size dark eyes, soft relaxed smile, loosely tied-back long dark hair and stray strands, realistic skin, white cotton crewneck T-shirt, medium-blue jeans and white low-top sneakers. Keep her natural adult proportions, subtle casual makeup, and the real clothing texture and construction. Preserve the ordinary residential courtyard, paving, pale wall and greenery, natural afternoon daylight, phone main-camera approximately 26 mm perspective, readable background, slight hand-held framing imperfection, mild phone compression and shadow noise. No portrait-mode fake bokeh, no beauty filter, no airbrushing, no studio glamour lighting, no cinematic grade, no glossy ad or fashion-editorial look. IMAGE 2 is only a body-pose and front-view reference. Change the fully clothed woman's pose to match its limb arrangement and support relationships; do not render the mannequin. Retain a relaxed human expression rather than a stiff display mannequin. Portrait 3:4, whole body with hands and shoes visible, one person, no collage, no text, no watermark. Do not mirror Image 2. Pose: the hand on the LEFT side of the image rests on her hip, elbow bent outward; opposite arm relaxed down at the RIGHT. Follow the pose reference's lateral hip shift, shoulder slope, unequal leg positions and foot directions while retaining credible human balance. The result should feel like a friend casually taking a phone photo of this woman posing in the same courtyard.
frames.observed: 全身扶腰与主色穿搭延续，可作为整组主图；脚尖、腰胯和面部细节仍与参考存在差异。
frames.revision: 复核面部、双鞋和腰胯细节。

frames.sourceArtifact: 原姿势图右上角有截断手臂碎片，提示词要求忽略该碎片。
frames.observed: 形成腰部以上近景，整理头发与肩前手势可辨，未出现原图右上角的额外手臂碎片；衣纹和庭院细节仍被重新生成。
frames.revision: 并排核对近景面部与基准，检查手指。

frames.title: 侧身结束
frames.purpose: 人物侧向树木，以环境和视线结束这一组。
frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, photorealistic-natural. This is one frame in a coherent six-photo series titled Courtyard Afternoon. IMAGE 1 is the mandatory reference for the SAME fictional 27-year-old adult East Asian woman and the SAME courtyard. Preserve her facial structure, naturally sized dark eyes, gentle relaxed smile, loosely tied-back dark hair and stray strands. frames.observed: 侧身朝向树木，形成结束画面；人物仍偏大，未达到约 45% 画面高度的中远景目标，背景几何也有变化。
frames.revision: 拉远机位，保留侧向树木的结束感。

assessment: Qualitative visual review only. All three new outputs retained, one attempt per new shot. No numerical identity/pose test, no calibrated camera or text-only control.
